Well kindof, you can use a 3rd party c++ library, like I used [libnyquist](https://github.com/ddiakopoulos/libnyquist), it just seems a little bit wasteful to have 2 decoders for all the formats. I'm alright with it though, I need gdnative for an [fft library](https://github.com/mborgerding/kissfft) anyway (the built-in spectrum analyzer is wayyy too imprecise for my niche use-case, and it's realtime too so the user would need to listen to the whole thing before anything else).
